summary: Frontend-only Expo/React Native web preview testing of Gym Personal app. All critical flows validated across 6 test suites: Dashboard, Biblioteca (83 ejercicios), Exercise detail (press-banca + sentadilla with knee warning), Rutinas (7 seed routines + create), Routine detail (edit, start), Workout Active (weight/reps/done/rest-timer/skip-rest/finish/confirm-finish), Progreso (charts render after workout), Ajustes (profile edit, units, goal, sub-screens), Rodilla protegida (all steppers + segments + toggles + counts), and Datos (export/import/CSV template). Persistence verified: routines and history survive page reload via localStorage keys (gym.routines.v1, gym.seeded.v1, etc). No red-screen or console errors — only harmless RN-Web deprecation warnings from third-party libs. No backend to test (100% local app).

react_native_issues.issue: Console shows 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings. Non-blocking but should be addressed for future RN Web compatibility. Likely coming from a shared UI component (Card/shadow styles) in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx or theme.

action_items: (Low priority) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow in shared UI components (Card, buttons) to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Low priority) Replace props.pointerEvents usages with style.pointerEvents in components that render Pressable/View wrappers.
critical_code_review_comments: GymStore.tsx importData callback lacks dependencies (uses setters only, ok), but the useCallback dependency array is [] — acceptable since setters are stable.
Web preview correctly persists via localStorage; storage abstraction under /app/frontend/src/utils/storage handles web/native transparently.
effectiveSafety() correctly blocks deepKnee exercises when knee.reducedRom is enabled — validated: 'Sentadilla con barra' shows 'Bloqueado por tu modo Rodilla protegida' banner.
exercises.ts merges exercises1.ts (39) + exercises2.ts (44) = 83, matching the UI subtitle '83 ejercicios'.
seed_data_creation: None — used built-in SEED_ROUTINES (7). Test also created 'TEST Rutina Nueva' and 'TEST Persistencia' via UI to verify create + persistence flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://gym-knee-trainer.preview.emergentagent.com. App is 100% local (no backend). All interactive elements expose kebab-case testID matching the review request. Key flows verified end-to-end: create routine -> start workout -> log weight/reps -> done -> rest-timer -> skip-rest -> finish-workout-btn -> confirm-finish -> /progreso (charts render). localStorage keys used: gym.routines.v1, gym.history.v1, gym.settings.v1, gym.knee.v1, gym.images.v1, gym.customExercises.v1, gym.active.v1, gym.intensityReduced.v1, gym.seeded.v1. Note: after 'create-routine-btn', app navigates directly to routine detail (expected UX).
